title: Glowing light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFE24D'/>
      <stop offset='75%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8C00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='45%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFB300' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='40' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <!-- bulb glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='24' fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#FFC94D' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- filament -->
  <path d='M43 44 L46 34 L50 42 L54 34 L57 44' fill='none' stroke='#FFF7C2' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- inner shine -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- collar -->
  <rect x='40' y='59' width='20' height='7' rx='2' fill='#C9D6E3'/>
  <rect x='40' y='60' width='20' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#EAF2FA'/>

  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#A7B4C2'/>
  <rect x='43' y='72' width='14' height='4.5' rx='1.5' fill='#93A1B0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='77.5' width='12' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#7F8D9C'/>

  <!-- tip -->
  <path d='M46 81.5 Q50 89 54 81.5 Z' fill='#6C7A89'/>
</svg>
